resolution.question: Will State President F. W. de Klerk personally deliver the customary opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of its February 1990 session?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that F. W. de Klerk personally delivered the opening address to the South African Parliament on or before 1990-02-06T18:00:00+02:00 (the hard cutoff), and during the first week of the February 1990 session, which begins on February 2, 1990. Resolve NO otherwise.
